# Policymaker #344, iteration 0057

## Owner action
Request filed in `.session/requests.json` (`question`). Install the reviewed store-readiness workflow, run it two times and commit the new redacted record. The numbered steps are in the request.

## What changed and why
- Review #342 accepted the revised workflow `policy/proposals/store-readiness.yml` (sha256 `53ac0f9d…`). Findings F1-F6 are closed. Reviewer models were copilot gpt-5.6-luna and Sonnet; the author was Claude. Two notes do not block (escaped issue JSON; the 403 path was not tested).
- Task #341 (manifest binding) ended `partial` on input_budget (copilot, 429k input) and made no change. I did not resume it.
- I wrote `execution/scripts/bind_manifest_n1.py`. It adds `bind_manifest()` to `benchmark/scripts/run_record.py`, adds three controls, updates one README sentence and one status sentence, and re-pins the evidence.
- Dry run (two times, on a copy of main, without LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT): 4 files change, and the second run changes nothing. `run_record.py`, `baseline.py`, `score.py` and evaluator `--check` give exit 0 with 62 references. When the equality test always passes, `run_record.py --check` gives exit 1.

## Orders (wake false, parallel, from main)
| Order | Expected gain | Check by next Policymaker |
|---|---|---|
| `apply-manifest-binding-n1` (benchmark, low, 20 min/25 turns) | Closes review #318 finding 4 (the last public defect of the run-record contract) | main `run_record.py` sha `48404c93…`, output has `manifest_binding` with 2 `rejected` entries, evaluator 62 references |
| `review-manifest-binding-n1` (reviewer, medium, 45 min/35 turns) | An independent verdict on the binding | verdict and numbered findings in its report |

Coverage and quality: no benchmark run occurred. The tool quality is not measured. Product implementation stays gated.

## What next
- Saved work: `execution/scripts/bind_manifest_n1.py`; memory section "Iteration 0057" in `policy/working-memory.md`.
- After the merge, delete the script. If the review accepts, update the "awaits independent review" sentences with a pin script. If the review says revise, fix the script. Do not order another blind fix.
- When the owner commits the new store record, order one independent review of that record. Then do gap items N2 (lineage adjudication, split by case family) and N3 (populated-manifest contract).
- Do not repeat the workflow review or the #341 attempt.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
